rawPayloadContract.description: Every captured public JSON object is retained unchanged inside the Provider as rawSource.payload and is readable only through the declared L3 source.raw field.

limitations: This is the complete locally captured development corpus, not the complete upstream FCC or Bitext datasets.
The development administrator overlay is not a production authorization policy.
The public snapshots retain their source licenses and capture manifests under tickets/ood/*/manifest.json.
